notes.title: [v1.0.0] Omega Crafter 1.0 is OUT now! 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]We’re excited to announce that Omega Crafter 1.0 has launched![/h2]
Check out the full release announcement trailer here↓↓↓
[previewyoutube=7_YHnA0hqVQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Based on feedback from players around the world, we’ve been working hard on Omega Crafter. [b]The 1.0 is packed with fun for both those already enjoying their adventure with the sidekick, Grammi, and newcomers just starting out. [/b]Don’t miss out—jump into the world of Omega and check out the celebratory events and new content!

[h3]Release Celebration Event #1: 30% OFF Sale[/h3]
Get Omega Crafter at 30% off for two weeks!

[h3]Release Celebration Event #2: Free Soundtrack on YouTube[/h3]
Alongside the release, we’re offering the full soundtrack with all 19 tracks featured in the game on Steam. Starting today, enjoy the entire soundtrack for free on YouTube for one month!
[previewyoutube=5Wr37yhJGOI;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Release Celebration Event #3: Omega Crafter Award[/h3]
To celebrate the addition of Creative Mode, we’re launching the Omega Crafter Award! Submit your architectural and programming creations for a chance to win.[b] Get all the details [url=https://forms.gle/KCst6BjBXgJWD6f79]here[/url].[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/525398db988745ea1ec138530af6b07e75f8fc8f.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Tips for 1.0[/h2]
[h3]1. Conquer the 5 Biomes![/h3]
From the "Meadows of New Beginnings" to the newly added fifth biome, the “Lost World,” explore each unique area and work your way up to the final boss battle.

In the “Lost World,” meteors rain down, causing heavy damage. Use the radar to track meteor cycles and towers to protect yourself from falling meteors. Collect items in dungeons to prepare for the ultimate showdown with the final boss!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/a26c387e744f7e0f1e38324175a5c1439d9acf0d.png[/img]

[h3]2. Enjoy Limitless Building with Creative Mode![/h3]
Building is one of the best parts of Omega Crafter, and now with the 1.0, we’ve added Creative Mode! With over 50 new building materials, there are now over 340 types to choose from!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/c6a7956cbc4f932311e23bdfd381ac2a9c0c471d.png[/img]
Creative Mode unlocks all materials from the start, and you can use them infinitely. Select it from the "World Setting" on the start screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/f9b2680a18a6819be11f8dbb2d93bb5fd12a0495.png[/img]
New materials have been added, including some that match the futuristic atmosphere of "Lost World"!

[h3]3. Complete the Shrines of Programming![/h3]
Based on feedback from early access players who wanted to do more programming, we’ve added this new content. [b]Combine blocks to solve puzzles and unlock rewards.[/b]
Explore the 25 shrines scattered across the 5 biomes and collect all the rewards!
[previewyoutube=MnBLH5u53tE;full][/previewyoutube]

[*] Removed stone from the materials required to create a portal.

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Monument messages now automatically close when other UI elements are opened.

[*] Added Russian to the language selection dialog.
[*] Adjusted the length of the HP gauge.
[*] Updated the logic for automatically adjusting the size and height of Grammi’s speech bubble UI.
[*] When selecting a container in coding templates to specify an item, containers that contain the item are now prioritized and listed higher.
[*] Updated the title screen image with a new version.
[*] Made several design adjustments.

[/list]

[list]

[*] Fixed an issue where the BGM sometimes failed to transition correctly after defeating a boss in multiplayer.
[*] Fixed an issue where some enemy voices could be heard from an excessive distance.
[*] Fixed an issue that allowed items to be Quick Stacked to the city while in a dungeon near the city.
[*] Fixed an issue where buttons inside a scroll view could remain in a “dragging” state and become unclickable.
[*] Fixed an issue where maximum HP gained from enchantments was not applied correctly at game start.
[*] Adjusted logic so that monsters inside the castle in Biome 4 are less likely to fall through the floor.
[*] Fixed an issue where HP recovery potions sometimes had no effect when PvP mode was enabled.
[*] Fixed an issue where buddy Grammis could get stuck near the Japanese castle stairs.
[*] Fixed an issue where action-type buildings would sometimes not function correctly after reloading the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where Grammi names would not display if the coding editor UI was closed immediately after execution.
[*] Fixed an issue where incorrect fonts were used in certain UI elements.
[*] Fixed an issue where IfElse blocks would not resume correctly after reloading the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the highlight for running blocks in the coding editor would sometimes not display properly.
[*] Fixed an issue where graves could spawn at dungeon entrances.
[*] Fixed an issue where parts of the Japanese castle floor in Biome 4 could shift and leave visible gaps.
[*] Fixed an issue where land areas were sometimes displayed as water on the map.
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉 Omega Crafter 1.0 Release Date Announced 🎉
notes.content:
[h2]Omega Crafter is leaving Early Access and launching into 1.0 on Wednesday, May 14, 2025 (PDT)![/h2]

[h3]1.0 will introduce the fifth biome, "Lost World," along with new features that will further enhance automation and building. [/h3]

1.0 Release Date Announcement Trailer (Short.ver)
[previewyoutube=SVVAVqi2GXI;full][/previewyoutube]

The feedback from all our players has been a tremendous help in developing Omega Crafter. We are so excited to announce the official release date. Thank you for all your support!

[u][b]Leading up to the release, we plan to share more detailed updates on Discord and X. Make sure to follow us to stay informed.[/b][/u] 

Here's a sneak peek of what's coming.

[h3][h2]Highlight #1: The Fifth Biome "Lost World"[/h2][/h3]
This biome features a sandy landscape with meteors raining down and ruined, futuristic structures scattered throughout. This new landscape is sure to spark fresh inspiration for your building and city-planning adventures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/3680dd945788486c35055dba78a594297cf040e3.png[/img]

[u][b]Protect Yourself from Meteors![/b][/u]
Meteors, which deal significant damage, will periodically rain down. Use the radar to track meteor cycles and the towers designed to protect against their impact as you explore and strengthen your equipment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/fbaaa7fbc99bfcf793f296ce394d51e19e5f3209.png[/img]

[u][b]The Story Reaches its Climax[/b][/u]
Collect sealed items in dungeons. Once you have gathered all the items, you'll face the final boss who has been hindering game development.

In addition to transformations, there will be disruptions from enemy characters, where even a moment's hesitation can be fatal. You'll also have to battle a "giant dark version" of a familiar character… Survive this thrilling battle to the end!

[h2]Highlight #2: Shrine of Programming[/h2]
An area that lets you delve deeper into the programming aspects of Omega Crafter. Once inside the shrine, you'll be tasked with creating a program based on a given prompt. Success will unlock items that make programming-integrated construction even easier.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/afc288ca7c03ccd9209415f8173eb79672f3474c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/eb5638335b696ec2b1e6808b84809167f972f7b2.png[/img]

There are a total of 25 Shrines of Programming scattered across all biomes, offering a unique take on automation that sets this apart from city-building automation!

[h2]Highlight #3: Building Updates & Creative Mode[/h2]
More than 50 new building materials will be added. Using items that can be collected in the "Lost World" as materials, you'll be able to engage in even more creative and elaborate building.

Additionally, a new "Creative Mode" will be available. All building materials are unlocked from the start, and resources are unlimited, allowing you to create your ideal world without any constraints.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/c6a7956cbc4f932311e23bdfd381ac2a9c0c471d.png[/img]

[u][b]Other Scheduled Updates[/b][/u]

Reverse item lookup list
Tutorial improvements
BGM changes in town
Skill additions
Mini-games
New items
Localization: New addition of Russian (machine translation)
System and performance improvements
and more!
[h2]Soundtrack Available Simultaneously![/h2]
Along with the 1.0 release (May 14, 2025), Omega Crafter's soundtrack will be available on Steam. It includes 19 tracks, such as field and battle themes for each biome.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484000/Omega_Crafter_Soundtrack/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484000/Omega_Crafter_Soundtrack/[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/19b51c688827fb154851290a15e15d31184dc9a4.png[/img]

During the time leading up to the release, we'll continue to share more detailed updates on Discord and our official X. Please join and follow from the list below!

notes.title: Omega Crafter’s 1st Anniversary! Celebrate with a Special Sale!
notes.content:
[h2]Celebrating One Year Since Early Access Launch 🎉[/h2]
We’ve reached this milestone thanks to all of you who have played Omega Crafter.
We truly appreciate your support!

[h3]To celebrate, we’re holding a 20% off anniversary sale![/h3]
We’ll also be sharing our future development plans soon—stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/132070128da31c7425642a31e0f224bf6067ac7b.png[/img]

A year ago, on March 28, 2024, Omega Crafter launched as a game combining automation through programming and survival crafting. While the development team believed in this unique concept, we also wondered how players would receive it.

However, after launch, we were amazed by the creative works shared by players—some perfected automation, while others programmed adorable behaviors for Grammi. Many unexpected and inventive ways to play emerged.

▶ In May 2024, we held the "Building Festival" event, showcasing incredible player creations!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262080/view/6361977949042504056?l=english

Seeing your shared works, gameplay videos, and player interactions inspired by Omega Crafter has been incredibly encouraging for our team.

We’ve also been continuously improving the survival crafting experience to make it even more engaging.

▶ June 2024: Controller Support Added
Due to high demand, we prioritized this update, making gameplay more comfortable for those who prefer controllers.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262080/view/4164221871986772188?l=english

▶ July 2024: Fishing Feature Added
You can automate fishing with Grammi!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262080/view/6382246858181449039?l=english

▶ October 2024: New Biome—“Island of the Samurai”
This update introduced a fourth biome, along with boats, gliders, new battles, and expanded building mechanics.
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262080/view/4697907940247419418?l=english

We’d love to hear even more feedback from you as we enter Omega Crafter’s second year.
Thank you for your continued support!

— The Omega Crafter Development Team

notes.title: [v0.9.0] Samurai Update: Japanese-Style items, New mechanics, and more!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce that the free update "0.9.0" for 'Omega Crafter' has been released on October 4th. Today’s update expands the journey with a new biome, Fallen Samurai Isle!
 
Check out the latest trailer!
[previewyoutube=0aPUB9l-3DQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Overview: New 4th biome: Fallen Samurai Isle[/h2]
Island-hop across Fallen Samurai Isle, a scenic archipelago where samurai once lived. Now, it has been taken over by enemies unique to the islands.
Explore ancient castles and abandoned households and  earn items from defeating monsters, all while heading toward the main boss. 

[h3]New Travel Methods[/h3]
Boats and gliders have been added as new travel methods. Boats will be necessary to go to Fallen Samurai Isle. Use a glider to get an aerial view of the new scenery.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/a9ca66c4efd2f413ab3209a867c04055220254d4.png[/img]
[h3]New Dungeon & Main Boss[/h3]
This update is our biggest to date, and adds a Japanese-style dungeon and new main boss waiting for you. Get ready for one of the most challenging battles in the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/1a52f31b7b60e63dffc9269fc41a282ebd5f2f13.png[/img]
[h3]Japanese-Style Architecture and Food[/h3]
Experiment with several new building materials that are characteristic of traditional Japanese aesthetics. Prepare traditional Japanese food like sushi and rice balls with the new Itamae Kitchen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/a5474bb985c2c38edecd580a03df7db719be200f.jpg[/img]

Fallen Samurai Isle also adds many new pieces of equipment and increases the world’s level cap!

[h2]▼"Samurai Update" Details[/h2]

[h3]New Features[/h3]

[b]Vehicles[/b]
[list]
[*] You can now travel quickly across seas and rivers using the "Boat." In multiplayer, up to six people can board the same boat. You can perform emotes by inputting the guard action while riding.
[*] The "Glider" allows you to glide swiftly through the air. Craft a glider at the "Workbench," equip it, and use the jump input mid-air to glide.
[/list]
[b]World Level[/b]
[list]
[*] The world level cap has been raised.
[*] The method for leveling up the world level has been significantly changed. The concept of "Bits" previously used has been abolished, and various materials and processed items are now required to unlock new world levels.
[*] While it's possible to continue playing with existing data, starting from the beginning will provide a different play experience than before. Please enjoy the more refined level design.
[/list]
[b]Quick Stack[/b]
[list]
[*] Say goodbye to tedious work! You can now store items in your inventory with one click. Items are automatically stored in stackable containers placed in the city.
[*] Open the inventory and press the Quick Stack button next to the sort button to activate.
[*] By default, hotbar items are excluded from Quick Stack, but you can change this in the "Misc" settings to include them.
[/list]
[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dual-Sword Ninja
[*] Haunted Sandal
[*] Umbrella Ghost
[*] Fury Monkey
[*] Lizard
[*] Oni Samurai
[*] Giant Frog
[*] Thunder God
[*] Iron Fist Frog
[*] Dominator of Rolling Thunder
[/list]
[h3]New Items[/h3]
[list]
[*] 21 new equipment items
[*] 10 new food ingredients
[*] 58 new building structures
[*] 32 new material items
[*] 2 new enchantment materials
[*] 3 new Grammi decorations
[*] 1 new potion
[*] 1 new arrow type
[*] 5 new fireworks
[/list]
[h3]New Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] New music has been added for "Fallen Samurai Isle."
[*] New music has been added for "Cave of Shattered Pixels" and "Haunted Process Mansion."
[/list]
[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*] New upgrade stages have been added to player skills and buddy skills, and overall balance has been adjusted. In particular, it's now easier to strengthen the HP and defense of buddy Grammis.
[*] Spears with status effects now apply those effects on the first hit of a jump attack.
[*] Overall equipment parameters have been adjusted.
[*] Drop items for some enemies have been adjusted.
[*] Required materials for some crafting items have been adjusted.
[*] Required materials for some buildings have been adjusted.
[*] The maximum stack number has been unified to 100 for many items, with some exceptions. For bow and arrow items, the maximum stack number has been unified to 1000.
[*] The time limit when a fish is caught on a fishing rod has been adjusted.
[*] The drop amount and HP of ore nodes have been adjusted.
[*] The cooldown time for the Rapid HP Recovery Potion has been reduced.
[/list]
[h3]Actions[/h3]
[list]
[*] When running out of stamina while dashing, you can now recover stamina without needing to release the dash input. Either wait until your stamina is fully recovered or input the dash action again to resume dashing.
[*] Jump attacks can now be canceled using mid-air jumps or glider glides.
[*] The player's guard animation has been adjusted.
[/list]
[h3]Grammi[/h3]
[list]
[*] When attempting to summon a buddy Grammi who is incapacitated, a failure message will now be displayed.
[*] Coding blocks specific to the Data Analyzer are now hidden in the list. They will still be visible in Grammi codes created before the update, but executing them will only display an error message above the Grammi's head without any other effect.
[*] The forestry template has been expanded to accommodate newly added wood-type items.
[*] The attack power of city Grammis has been strengthened.
[/list]
[h3]QoL[/h3]
[list]
[*] When stacking items into a single container in town, hotbar items are excluded by default. You can change this in the "Misc" settings to include them.
[/list]
[h3]UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a button to reset the "Misc" tab in settings.
[*] The sorting order of recipes within the construction menu has been partially changed.
[*] The enchantment UI has been adjusted.
[*] The tablet UI has been adjusted.
[*] Changed the icon display to make it easier to see at a glance which items can be crafted or built.
[*] Some icons have been changed.
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] The number of tutorials skipped when skipping the tutorial has been adjusted.
[/list]
[h3]Text[/h3]
[list]
[*] Text related to "Bits" has been changed.
[/list]
[h3]Audio[/h3]
[list]
[*] The volume of the SE when opening and closing iron doors has been adjusted.
[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] Changed the rendering method to Forward+.
[*] Updated the rendering target for Reflection Probes.
[*] Adjusted shadow rendering parameters.
[*] The appearance of some items has been adjusted.
[*] The effect when crops in fields are completed has been hidden.
[/list]
[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved the performance of the sparkling effect displayed on collectible items.
[*] Changed the size of some textures.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where food-dropping plants could reset to a state where they would drop food again immediately after teleporting.
[*] Fixed a bug where continuously pressing the down key on a controller in the town symbol dialog would cause directional inputs to stop working.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/022e56ca7d078617e499d6c94634f95d477f3c64.jpg[/img]
Thank you for all of your feedback. Have fun with Omega Crafter!🎉

notes.title: [Omega Crafter Devlog#5] New feature “leveling the ground”!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is the Omega Crafter dev-team.
In today’s Devlog#5, we will introduce a new feature “leveling-the-ground” recently incorporated into Omega Crafter!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/4d7f702d8bf8dac708ae9c88cb6d80ab9ecc2622.png[/img]

We have implemented a “leveling the ground” action for the Grammi city, in response to the strong requests from city-building lovers 🎉🎉🎉
The world of Omega Crafter has a natural, undulating terrain, which we can flatten with the “leveling the ground” action.

Elaborating for the survival craft game experts, the player can level the ground in a way that aligns with the height of the ground the player is standing on. One “leveling” action creates one square of flattened tile on the city, making it easy to level a large area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/e2f09848cc8ac25e21c258e10acdfa8b836501be.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/a35a97339da8f92ef7018521bf0785bf4f8e481c.png[/img]

We can build an even more massive city with this new feature! We can easily pick a place to set up our base without locating a large area suitable for it, because we can now enlarge our base by leveling the ground 👍

We recommend players use the leveling action to build a Grammi’s house or factory. It would be a good idea to do it when Grammi fails to navigate their way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/3e3688144632dd17d3484ddb3ffd8dce48222f44.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/b3475dd5da0b35e274dbb5eeb2e4262208ebeb75.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/4d7f702d8bf8dac708ae9c88cb6d80ab9ecc2622.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/7c8b80552e47bfbfb53db4369513454123fbd386.png[/img]

We can even do something like these pictures with some work!
The new feature might change how we develop our city…!?

That’s all for today’s news from the Omega Crafter dev-team. Thank you!

notes.title: [Omega Crafter Devlog#3] We added marker objects by which we can guide Grammis!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, this is the Omega Crafter dev-team.
Today’s post Devlog#3 delivers the recent developmental update on the city building in Omega Crafter - “marker” object.

As we received many requests saying “we would like to designate the route on which a Grammi travels” or “we would love to watch Grammis running in a race” from open alpha test players, we have implemented two objects, “marker” and “directed marker” object!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/5ca6d953b171357cbf6768e7949da52628c2118e.jpg[/img]

A marker object is so small a building object that Grammis would not stumble on it. You can let Grammis wherever you designate to go with the marker object and a “Move” coding block.
A directed marker object is a marker object with an effect indicating its direction. You can let a Grammi go to a specific point and turn to a specific direction with certain blocks.

In the alpha test, many players may have encountered the situation that Grammis was pushing and shoving. This can be helped by marker objects introduced in this article!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/f18f50fece57bdf8ab6c21c758b88770a34234f2.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/3b9a851ce3fabe9c297f54d2665ff6b9ebc34352.jpg[/img]

One possible usage of marker objects is to guide or line-up Grammis.

It would be good to introduce marker objects if you want to build an efficient workplace for Grammis. Grammis are pretty smart to select their routes by themselves, but sometimes they fail to for some reasons. In such a case, we recommend you to use marker objects to guide Grammis to make things better.

Marker objects are very convenient when you want to take a game-play snapshot for social media. You can take a lovely photo by using marker objects as spots for actors in the scene.

The marker and directed marker objects (with the “Move” coding block) help you to control how Grammis move in the world. Enjoy your city-building with marker objects when a playable version of Omega Crafter is out!

That’s all for today’s news from the Omega Crafter dev-team. Thank you!

notes.title: [Omega Crafter Devlog#2] We have added a string board convenient for automation!
notes.content:
Hi there! This is the Omega Crafter dev-team.
On today’s post devlog#2, we will feature a new building object “string board”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/5d077c02c3fb9aa6c9f672851b71718e28870318.jpg[/img]

After the open-alpha test, we have added a “string board” object.
A string board object is a building-type object from which Grammis can read a string and on which they can write a string. The string written on the string board is displayed on the game object in the 3D world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/32aa69fe46055293ab642fe1f096ba973753d442.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/07181c2ea0a75d4b8e54ac1affcd4f8f870b8e67.jpg[/img]

As we can display whatever string we want on a string board, it can be used as a sign board in the city. For example, we can put up a nameplate “XX’s house” in front of a residence, or a signboard “XX’s workplace” in front of a workplace.

We can also let it be a message board for Grammis, where they post their comments by coding blocks. We believe the string board provides another way for Grammis to express their feelings, in addition to facial expressions and poses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/91144954e531fcd01e621c352468d03506f3064c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/ab46116c0e9cdbda9ea529611a5b76d6108ec8de.jpg[/img]

These are not the only use cases for string boards. As automation/programming professionals probably noticed, string boards are really convenient especially for Omega Crafter. We hope you find wonderful ways to use string boards when you play Omega Crafter.

That’s all for today’s news from the Omega Crafter dev-team. Thank you!

notes.title: [Omega Crafter Devlog#1] Multi-story building is now supported!
notes.content:
Hello to all the passionate fans of Omega Crafter!

We previously shared our dev-roadmap on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2262080/view/3662038171195538295]Steam NEWS[/url]. Have you seen it?

As the news says, we have been developing the core of the multi-play system, and will implement a great number of building and programming elements. Our dev-team is striving toward the open-beta test in autumn or winter and the early-access version release in winter.

Now that our dev-roadmap has been published, we have determined to report the progress of the development on a regular basis. We will do our best to share with you the latest version of Omega Crafter growing up with great force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/dea6d6f17ec290f56afdef65bea3ccc56b57e11c.png[/img]

On this post devlog#1, we will introduce “multi-story building”, which many open-alpha test players wanted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/6929586c8089db87933b0caa42f6d0fd7ca8c63a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/ef485a6404a4a24c9c58a1a8b75dad9dc5c7a68a.jpg[/img]

After the open-alpha test in May, we implemented “floor” and  “stairway” objects.

A floor object is, as its name suggests, a building part used as the floor of a house. Players can place another building object on floors, which enables them to put Grammis to work in a Grammi’s private workshop.

A stairway object is a building part to go higher. Not only player characters but also Grammis can go up and down stairs, so one may consider to build intersecting traffic lines of Grammis.

There were several technical challenges to enable Grammis to go up and down stairs, but our dev-team has realized that with a strong will to meet the requests from the fans of Omega Crafter. We would like to talk about what went on behind the scenes sometime.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/78f41d972e05be865a2004f93cb95f53ee0f7179.jpg[/img]

The floor and stairway objects have brought a wonderful feature, multi-story building to Omega Crafter!

The multi-story building system allows a greater degree of freedom in building a residence or workplace; We can enjoy building a gorgeous two-story residence for players and an efficient-oriented two-story workplace for Grammis. We believe this is good news for both players who love city-building and ones who are passionate about automation.

We are very happy to realize multi-story building because we have received a lot of requests “wanna build a two-story house in Omega Crafter!” on the open-alpha test. On the upcoming open-beta test and after the release, we would like to see your awesome buildings using floor objects and stairway objects :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43402483/880c249bd7bc6ba77892fd419deceae4b179115e.jpg[/img]

That’s all for today’s news from the Omega Crafter dev-team. Thank you!
